note: Vendored packages, copied here and never patched in place: a patched copy is a fork nobody declared. content_sha256 is sha256 over (relative path + file bytes) for each .py file, concatenated in sorted relative-path order, __pycache__ excluded; the authoritative statement of that algorithm is gates/check_vendor_digests.py::digest(), which recomputes both values on every verify run. path+bytes rather than bytes alone, because bytes alone cannot see a rename or content moving between two files. monorepo_revision names the source commit the bytes were last taken from.
